Caught and fixed 3 real, chapter-specific converter gaps at the manual read-back / screenshot review stage (none were hypothetical): (1) \alpha (the alpha PARTICLE, ex_12.2, and the Sommerfeld fine-structure constant, q_12.6) was missing from the inherited GREEK table entirely -- rendered as the literal word 'alpha' on every occurrence; added to GREEK. (2) An escaped underscore '\_' (q_12.1's five fill-in-the-blank MCQ parts, each with a run of four '\_' as the blank marker) fell through unhandled, and the bare underscore left behind was then mis-consumed by the subscript-operator branch, making the entire blank marker vanish with nothing left to show a student where to write an answer -- added explicit '\_' -> literal '_' handling. (3) q_12.6 part (a)'s own $$...$$ block has a \begin{aligned} NESTED inside another \begin{aligned} of the SAME name (a genuine Mathpix OCR artifact already present in the raw 01_mathpix conversion, not something authored here) -- the inherited _protect_envs()'s same-name-backreference regex mismatched the pairing (matched the outer \begin against the INNER's \end), leaving one \begin{aligned}/\end{aligned} pair unprotected and rendering as literal 'beginaligned'/'endaligned' text glued onto the page. Rewrote _protect_envs() to use a proper depth-counting scan (matching \begin/\end purely by nesting depth, not by env-name equality) instead of a same-name backreference regex -- this generalizes correctly to any same-name nesting depth, not just this one occurrence.
